text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Melbourne. Which public liability lawyers are best?

result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Melbourne. Which public liability lawyers are best?
result.markdown:
I am so sorry to hear that you slipped and fell. Dealing with an injury from a shopping centre accident can be stressful, especially when medical bills and time off work start to pile up.

When looking for the "best" public liability lawyers in Melbourne for a shopping centre slip and fall, the right choice usually depends on firms that specialize heavily in personal injury, offer a **No Win, No Fee** arrangement, and have a proven track record dealing with major commercial entities or shopping centre landlords/insurers.

Several well-known and reputable personal injury law firms operating across Melbourne handle these exact types of public liability and slip-and-fall claims:

* **Henry Carus + Associates:** Highly specialized in slip, trip, and fall accidents in public and commercial spaces across Melbourne, with a strong emphasis on detailed onsite investigations.
* **Slater and Gordon:** One of Australia's best-known personal injury and public liability firms with extensive experience handling shopping centre and supermarket claims across multiple Melbourne suburban and CBD offices.
* **Law Partners:** Well-regarded for personal injury claims in Victoria, offering dedicated case management and a strong focus on client support and maximum compensation recovery.
* **Shine Lawyers:** A large national firm with multiple offices across Greater Melbourne (such as the CBD, Dandenong, and Sunshine) handling public place and retail negligence claims.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/service/public-liability-claims-vic#:~:text=Shine's%20public%20liability%20lawyers%20in%20Melbourne%20%26,Our%20No%20Win%20No%20Fee*%20cost%20agreement.)
* **National Compensation Lawyers:** Dedicated personal injury firm assisting clients specifically with retail, supermarket, and shopping centre slip-and-fall incidents on a no-win, no-fee basis.[nationalcompensationlawyers.com.au](https://nationalcompensationlawyers.com.au/slip-and-fall-lawyers-melbourne/#:~:text=You%20won't%20pay%20any%20legal%20fees%20unless,Compensation%20Claims%20%E2%80%93%20No%20Win%2C%20No%20Fee.)

---

### Immediate Steps to Protect Your Claim

If you haven't already, keeping a few key things in mind can significantly strengthen a potential public liability claim against a shopping centre:

1.  **Report the Incident:** Ensure the shopping centre management or security logged an official incident report. Request a copy if possible.
2.  **Preserve Evidence:** Keep photos of the hazard (e.g., a spill, a leak, uneven flooring) if you took any, along with photos of your injuries. Save the shoes and clothing you were wearing.
3.  **Seek Medical Attention:** See a doctor immediately to document your injuries and link them directly to the fall.
4.  **No Win, No Fee:** Most reputable personal injury lawyers in Melbourne offer a free initial consultation and operate on a "No Win, No Fee" basis, meaning you don't pay legal fees unless they successfully recover compensation for you.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-melbourne#:~:text=Many%20of%20our%20team%20are%20Melbourne%20locals,your%20case.%20No%20Win%2C%20No%20Fee%20Lawyers.)
